t: Buy Direct from Manufacturers: When It Works & When Not
s: December 1, 2025 - You’re able to request small changes or new versions that better suit your buyers, instead of settling for ready-made items that dozens of retailers already carry. The process feels more collaborative, almost like building your own line from the ground up. For retailers aiming for differentiation, this level of customization becomes a meaningful advantage. Factory-direct purchasing gives you more influence over how things move. You can check lead times, materials, and production schedules without waiting on updates from intermediaries.
